name: Salve of Swift Healing
summary: A salve that closes wounds in the space of a heartbeat.
description: Rubbed on cuts and burns, it smells of mint and iron. Midwives keep a jar under the bed.

stats.effect: You can apply this salve as a Bonus Action to yourself or a creature within 5 feet. The target regains 4d4 + 4 hit points and ends the {ref:condition/poisoned} condition on itself.
